caption: Tuna peas fritters for babies & toddlers 🤍 Easy, soft, and packed with protein + nutrients. Ingredients: • 1 cup peas (well cooked) • 145g tuna (low sodium, in water) • 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese • 2 eggs • ¼ cup flour • 1 tsp butter (for cooking) Directions: Cook peas until very soft, then mash well (they should be easily squishable). Add tuna, mozzarella, eggs, and flour. Mix until combined. Heat a pan with butter on medium-low heat. Scoop mixture and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 👉 Make sure peas are very soft for safe eating. Feeding your baby every day doesn’t have to feel overwhelming.
